svg.text: Protocol stack — one transport, two encodings, two flows
Everything below the encoding row is shared by both flows. Only the air message leaves JSON behind.
ITS release-2 codec, LGPLv3, behind one codec seam
one message per datagram · no broker and no middleware
static addresses 10.99.0.10 to .13 · one subnet, so no routing
